<DOCSTRING>
Returns the current timestamp as an integer.

This method is used to obtain the current time in seconds since the Unix epoch, which is useful for generating time-stamped logs, tracking events, or any scenario requiring a precise timestamp.
</DOCSTRING>

<DOCSTRING>
Args:
    self: The instance of the class, required for method access.

Returns:
    int: The current timestamp in seconds since the Unix epoch.
</DOCSTRING>
